## Introduction

In this assignment I import data from three sources:

1. A CSV file
2. A statistical package (SPSS, Stata and SAS files)
3. A database management system (MySQL)
4. A built-in R dataset
5. A web API

For each dataset I display the first 5 rows.

Packages used: `haven`, `DBI`, `RMySQL` and `jsonlite`.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# installing libraries
# install.packages("haven")
# install.packages("DBI")
# install.packages("RMySQL")
# install.packages("jsonlite")
```

## 1. Importing a CSV file

The file `sample.csv` is in the same folder as this R Markdown file, so I only need the file name.

```{r}
csv_data <- read.csv("sample.csv")
head(csv_data, 5)
```

## 2. Importing data from a statistical package

I used the `haven` package that reads files from SPSS, Stata and SAS.
I used the example files that come with the package.

### SPSS file (.sav)

```{r}
library(haven)

spss_data <- read_sav(system.file("examples", "iris.sav", package = "haven"))
head(spss_data, 5)
```

### Stata file (.dta)

```{r}
stata_data <- read_dta(system.file("examples", "iris.dta", package = "haven"))
head(stata_data, 5)
```

### SAS file (.sas7bdat)

```{r}
sas_data <- read_sas(system.file("examples", "iris.sas7bdat", package = "haven"))
head(sas_data, 5)
```

## 3. Importing data from a database (MySQL)

I connect to the `NewLifeHospital` database on my computer and read the `Patients` table.

```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RMySQL)

# The password is saved in my .Renviron file, not in this file
con <- dbConnect(MySQL(), dbname = "NewLifeHospital", host = "localhost",
                 user = "root", password = Sys.getenv("MYSQL_PASSWORD"))

patients <- dbReadTable(con, "Patients")
head(patients, 5)
```

Close the connection when finished:

```{r}
dbDisconnect(con)
```
## 4. Importing data from a built-in library

R comes with the `datasets` package, which has ready-made datasets. I load the `mtcars` dataset.

```{r}
data("mtcars")
head(mtcars, 5)
```

## 5. Importing data from an API

a `jsonlite` package reads JSON data from a web API. I use JSONPlaceholder, a free practice API that needs no account or key.

```{r}
library(jsonlite)

todos <- fromJSON("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos")
head(todos, 5)
```


## Conclusion

I imported a CSV file using `read.csv()`, data from SPSS, Stata and SAS files using the `haven` package, and data from a MySQL database using `DBI` and `RMySQL`. The first 5 rows of each dataset were displayed with `head()`. I also loaded the built-in `mtcars` dataset using `data()`. I also imported data from a web API using `fromJSON()` from the `jsonlite` package.
